objective: Produce measurable, persistent, individually distinct economic behavior whose trajectory depends on causal seed, changing state, memory, appraisal, goals, context, constraints, uncertainty, and experience.

claim_boundary.implemented: Deterministic causal identities, bounded multi-timescale adaptation, context habits, prediction-error learning, structured memory, ordered episode traces, and longitudinal fixtures.
claim_boundary.aspirational: Increasing resemblance to human economic behavior over time.

memory.episodic: Immutable episode-linked structured records used in retrieval.
memory.semantic: Consolidated structured summaries; audit episodes are retained.
memory.procedural: Decision outcomes update action-specific habits within the experienced context; procedural records participate in later retrieval.
memory.self_narrative: Versioned structured continuity and identity interpretations.
memory.retrieval: At most five items weighted by recency, similarity, salience, and identity relevance.

cognition.fast_proposals: Opportunity/threat appraisal proposes observe, buy, or sell tendencies.
cognition.deliberation: Probability rises with surprise, conflict, uncertainty, stakes, accountability and post-error checking; falls with load and time pressure.
cognition.attention_budget: Retrieval is capped and energy/load are stateful.
cognition.uncertainty: Explicit in appraisal, deliberation, attribution and action values.
cognition.structured_variability: Selection temperature rises near ambiguity and goal conflict, while confidence and established context habits reduce it.
cognition.decision_latency: Computed latency rises with attention, ambiguity, conflict, stakes, retrieval and deliberation; no artificial sleeping is introduced.

choice.mechanism: Seeded probability distribution over every option; motives never map directly to an action.

learning.update_rules: baseRate * (1 + 2 * exp(-episodeCount / 25)); state and priors use separate caps; reward prediction error drives bounded prior, expectation and habit updates.
learning.attribution: Each trace records internal, external and uncertainty contributions.
learning.consolidation: Durable identity adjustment requires 12 consistent episodes across 3 contexts.
learning.habits: Outcome-linked action habits are context-specific, bounded, individually rate-limited and weakened by adverse prediction errors.
learning.recovery: Adverse prediction errors temporarily raise recovery load and post-error checking; both decay with elapsed time.
learning.state_decay: Fast and medium state variables return toward individually derived baselines at distinct half-lives.
learning.sequential_effects: Recent action runs create bounded inertia after neutral or positive outcomes and interruption after adverse outcomes.
learning.self_model: Competence, agency and prudence change only during evidence-qualified cross-context consolidation.

narrative_self.format: Structured versioned JSON, never fabricated autobiographical prose.
narrative_self.continuity: Existing seeds and history survive alias changes, restarts and master-key rotation.

episode_traces: normal market observation with bounded update
high-stakes uncertain episode with increased deliberation
negative outcome with attribution, memory and recovery-capable learning

timescales.immediate: attention, appraisal, proposal and action tendency
timescales.short: affect, arousal, load, recovery and post-error checking with elapsed-time decay
timescales.medium: learned priors, reference expectations, context habits and remembered outcomes
timescales.long: identity and structured self-model adjustment after cross-context evidence
timescales.developmental: persisted causal seed and autobiographical continuity

evaluation.baseline: Deterministic replay, trace completeness, bounds, schema migration and secret-leak suites.
evaluation.counterfactuals: Ten paired directional fixtures; at least 80 percent must pass.
evaluation.longitudinal: Fifty common episodes across eight agents; retain at least 60 percent baseline identity distance.

safety_integrity.ownership: Separate wallets do not imply separate beneficial owners.
safety_integrity.secrets: Wallet secrets remain process environment only and are never persisted, returned or logged.

migration_versioning: State schema v1 is upgraded in place to v2 on the next episode without resetting revision, episode count, memory or identity. Seed, state, event and evaluation schemas version independently. Persisted identities are not regenerated during key rotation.
